about: The tools OSCR recognizes in the stored scripts (oscr/repofeatures.py). Names per language are import names (python, r, julia), function names (matlab), command names (shell; '$NAME' is an environment variable); a trailing '*' makes a prefix. 'packages' are distribution names (PyPI, conda, apt, modules, container images) when they differ from the import names; 'files' are file-name patterns that belong to the tool.
rrids: each RRID was checked on the SciCrunch resolver on 2026-09-26; '' when none was confirmed

tools.name: Tools for NIfTI and ANALYZE image (MATLAB)
